result.note: Mostly outbreak reporting; tested only the institutional responses by the NGT and NHRC.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about institutional responses to drinking water contamination in India in January 2026:
items: The National Green Tribunal took action over reports of sewage contamination in drinking water across parts of Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.
The National Human Rights Commission issued a notice over a typhoid surge in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, linked to contaminated supply.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both are correct. The NGT acted on sewage contamination reports across three states, and the NHRC separately issued a notice over the Gandhinagar typhoid surge. These responses followed a diarrhoea outbreak in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, that killed at least nine and hospitalised over 200 people.
questions.source: Separately, the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) issued a notice over a typhoid surge in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, tied to contaminated supply on January 8.
